verdict.rationale: Kimi ships built-in agents that take delegated tasks. Kimi Code Desktop and the CLI let the agent read code, edit files, run commands and autonomously complete development tasks. The kimi.com assistant invites users to "do an Agent task" and documents an agent mode, agent clusters, and agent-built webpages. Missing for 10: the consumer agent-mode, agent-cluster and scheduled-task capabilities appear only as help-center index titles without in-depth docs, and there is little independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
